findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential symlink race condition in file operations
 * @description File operations that check file properties before use may be vulnerable to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/filelock-symlink-race
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 *        external/cwe/cwe-59
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string funcName
where
  (
    // Check for os.path.exists followed by file operations
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember("exists").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember("isfile").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember("isdir").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember("exists").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember("is_file").getACall()
  ) and
  funcName = call.getFunction().(DataFlow::AttrRead).getAttributeName()
select call, "File existence check '" + funcName + "' may be vulnerable to race conditions if followed by file operations."
findings.hypothesis: Check for Time-of-Check-Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) vulnerabilities where file operations don't properly handle symlinks or race conditions

message.text: File existence check 'exists' may be vulnerable to race conditions if followed by file operations.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure file permissions in file lock creation
 * @description File lock files created without explicit secure permissions may be accessible by unintended users
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/filelock-insecure-permissions
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-732
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall()
  ) and
  // Check if the call is in filelock module
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%filelock%") and
  // Check if mode parameter is not specified or doesn't restrict permissions
  not exists(call.getArgByName("mode"))
select call, "File operation without explicit secure permissions may create files with overly permissive access."
findings.hypothesis: File operations without explicit secure permissions may create files with overly permissive access

message.text: File operation without explicit secure permissions may create files with overly permissive access.
